nodes.description: Public view function isContract(address addr) returns bool; performs an inline-assembly extcodesize check on the supplied address.
Input parameter addr of type address, supplied by the caller and used as the argument to the extcodesize assembly opcode.
Local stack variable size (uint) that receives the result of the extcodesize(addr) assembly call.
Inline assembly block invoking extcodesize(addr); low-level opcode usage that returns 0 for contracts still under construction, making the resulting contract check unreliable.

edges.reason: Function body execution enters the inline assembly block that executes extcodesize.
Caller-supplied address parameter addr is passed directly into the extcodesize assembly opcode.
The value produced by extcodesize(addr) is assigned to the local variable size.
Local variable size is compared with 0 and its boolean result is returned by the function.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter addr has no independent identity outside the function; it is only consumed as the argument of the extcodesize assembly operation, so it should be normalized into that unsafe_operation.

The local variable size exists solely to hold the return value of the extcodesize assembly operation and is immediately used in the return comparison, so it should be normalized into that unsafe_operation.
